failures.result: Production proxy closed the non-streamed response after 1002.62 seconds; the client observed RemoteDisconnected.
failures.root_cause: http.Server.WriteTimeout was 10 minutes. The backend completed after the absolute write deadline, so ReverseProxy could not deliver the response.
failures.recovery: A candidate proxy with WriteTimeout disabled returned the same 201031-token prompt in 1001.06 seconds with 10/10 planted facts. After releasing commit 8eae500, the deployed proxy returned another 201031-token run in 970.91 seconds, HTTP 200, with 10/10 recall and no fallback.
failures.interpretation: The model and 256K configuration were healthy; the failure was the homelab proxy's response deadline, not a context-window or memory failure.
